# 因為 …，所以 … · *jan1 wai6 …, so2 ji5 …*

**Meaning:** because …, so … · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Connecting words

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fjan1-wai6-because).

因為 introduces the reason and 所以 the result. Unlike English, using both in one sentence is normal. Either half can also stand alone.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **因為落雨，所以我冇出街。** |
| Jyutping | jan1 wai6 lok6 jyu5, so2 ji5 ngo5 mou5 ceot1 gaai1. |
| Yale | yān waih lohk yúh, só yíh ngóh móuh chēut gāai. |
| Bopomofo | ㄧㄜㄣ¹ ㄨㄜㄧ⁶ ㄌㄛㆶ⁶ ㄩ⁵, ㄙㄛ² ㄧ⁵ ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄇㄛㄨ⁵ ㄘㆤㆵ¹ ㄍㄚㄧ¹. |
| English | Because it was raining, I didn't go out. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我好攰，因為尋日好夜先瞓。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 hou2 gui6, jan1 wai6 cam4 jat6 hou2 je6 sin1 fan3. |
| Yale | ngóh hóu guih, yān waih chàhm yaht hóu yeh sīn fan. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄍㄨㄧ⁶, ㄧㄜㄣ¹ ㄨㄜㄧ⁶ ㄘㄜㆬ⁴ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄧㄝ⁶ ㄙㄧㄣ¹ ㄈㄜㄣ³. |
| English | I'm tired because I went to bed late last night. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **因為佢病咗，所以今日唔返工。** |
| Jyutping | jan1 wai6 keoi5 beng6 zo2, so2 ji5 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1. |
| Yale | yān waih kéuih behng jó, só yíh gām yaht m̀h fāan gūng. |
| Bopomofo | ㄧㄜㄣ¹ ㄨㄜㄧ⁶ ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄅㄝㄥ⁶ ㄗㄛ², ㄙㄛ² ㄧ⁵ ㄍㄜㆬ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㆬ⁴ ㄈㄚㄣ¹ ㄍㄨㄥ¹. |
| English | Because she's ill, she isn't going to work today. |
